meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按调试流程查证 bug 的运行时与源码证据，判断归属于哪个仓库，产出一篇英文 GitHub issue（只有 openai/codex 才可能开 PR），含复现步骤、根因、修复建议和验证计划。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个安装器 bug 报个 issue，带上复现步骤和根因
say.note: 会先查证再决定发到哪个仓库

say.text: 先搜下这个报错有没有已有 issue，有就补评论
say.note: 匹配到 open issue 时改为追加证据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows a debugging workflow to gather runtime and source evidence, decides which repo owns the bug, and files an English GitHub issue (a PR only in openai/codex) with reproduction steps, root cause, fix guidance, and a verification plan.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: File an issue for this installer bug with repro steps and root cause
say_en.note: It checks evidence first, then picks the repo

say_en.text: This Codex CLI crash reproduces without LazyCodex; file upstream
say_en.note: Routes to openai/codex with source evidence

say_en.text: Search for an existing issue on this error first
say_en.note: Adds a comment if a matching open issue exists
